programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out…

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan…

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: After many years as a respected actor and action choreographer, the Shaw Studio finally gave the dependable and commendable Hsu Hsia a chance to direct his own movies. He didn't waste the opportunity, inviting three other kung-fu designers to help on this fight-filled thriller. Wang Yu, co-star of such classics as Dirty Ho and The Kid With A Tattoo, here takes center stage as a young rascal caught between an anti-Ching Confederation and violent, vengeful Ching troops. But when he discovers that the good guys are led by master martial arts actor Jen Shih-kuan and the bad guys are led by the incredible Huang Cheng-li everyone knows that loads of great kung-fu is in store.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin…

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancée to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhen's family appears to get along but harbours deep secrets. Mei Zhen is trapped in a dead-end job with a toxic boss, her brother hides his separation and their mother grapples with lingering guilt over her husband's departure years ago. As Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, can the family heal their wounds and find a way back to each other?

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a person's subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma…

programme.title: We Girls
programme.desc: To afford a 200,000-yuan cochlear implant for her daughter, Gao takes a desperate risk that lands her in prison. During her time there, and after her release, she befriends three women. Despite their different personalities, they form a close bond to defy fate and support each other through hardship.

programme.title: Detective vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves “The Chosen Sleuths". Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real “Chosen Sleuth” instead of a lunatic.

programme.title: Just 1 Day
programme.desc: Mosaic, an urban sketcher, is suffering from ALS and wants to create some fond memories as his condition worsens. When Mosaic reunites with his old classmate Angelfish, whom he has a crush on since primary school, he asks her to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day. Will Angelfish say “yes”?

programme.title: The Sunny Side of the Street
programme.desc: Hassan is a Pakistani refugee boy whose father has died in a car accident. A local taxi driver, Yat, then helps him flee Hong Kong. In the process, the two gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the shocking truth about his father's death…

programme.title: Love is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: Bo lost her eye sight in a serious car accident a year ago. One day, she is left alone at home when her husband is away on a work trip. An intruder enters Bo's house and takes her hostage. As Bo tries to survive his mental and psychological torture, she discovers her husband's secret which is related to the accident leading to her blindness…

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the Kowloon Walled City while fleeing, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom. Bonding with Shin, Twelfth Master and AV, they unite under Tornado's leadership to defend against the villain, Mr Big's assaults, and pledge to protect the safe haven of the Walled City together.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A killer and a stage actor accidentally swapped their identities at a bathhouse. The actor must complete the killer's mission while the killer thinks he is a hopeless actor after losing his memory during the accident. When the killer strives to become a successful stage actor, he also starts to recall what has happened…

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: After it is discovered that the drugs seized on the Chinese ships had been planted by the henchman of a notorious drug cartel leader named Naw Khar, the governments of Thailand, Laos, Myanmar and China launched a joint task force to apprehend the criminal by sending a band of elite narcotics officers to the Golden Triangle to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Daily's Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army.

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: On the final day of a shocking murder trial in Hong Kong, a renowned hypnotherapist serving as a juror receives a video showing his daughter being kidnapped. The abductors demand that he hypnotize the jury to manipulate the final verdict. Torn between justice and family, he must decide how far he is willing to go to save her.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into "haunted flats", which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: Come Back Home
programme.desc: In a chilly winter, De and his family goes on a self-drive tour to Changbai Mountain. The holiday turns tragic when De's eight-year-old son goes missing. He seeks help from the local police but is unable to find his son. Though the golden hour has passed, De and the rescue team insist on continuing the search. Can they finally rescue the boy?

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: Set in a snowbound, surreal Hong Kong, a tycoon who also secretly rules the drug trade is killed in an explosion, plunging the city into chaos. With police paralysed and the family businesses in turmoil, his youngest son vows to dismantle the family's empire, but is thwarted by his fugitive brother and his father's followers fighting for control.

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the club's top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: Arjuna EP3
programme.desc: Yo bergegas ke balai raya lalu memukul beduk untuk mengalihkan perhatian penduduk kampung yang sedang di panggang di atas bara api yang besar. Dengan lantas, Asya diselamatkan dan dia memberitahu bahawa sikap penduduk tiba-tiba berubah kerana sebenarnya kuasa jahat sudah menguasai diri dan fikiran mereka.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP25
programme.desc: Memaparkan pengantara Detik 12 Malam saudara Saiful Azmi Jamsari dengan dibantu krew produksi melakukan penyiasatan tentang kisah misteri yang berlaku di Pekan Arang Batu, Rawang, Selangor. Mereka cuba merungkai misteri yang berlaku di kilang lama dan lombong Arang Baru yang telah ditinggalkan. Beliau menemu bual Pak Jabar seorang penduduk tempatan dan bekas pekerja di situ bagi berkongsi pengalaman dan latar belakang tempat tersebut. Pak Jabar pernah ternampak lembaga berambut panjang dengan wajah yang hodoh. Pengantara kemudiannya menemu bual Tok Bugis seorang Penjejak Paranormal mempunyai kelebihan nampak lembaga misteri. Pengantara sendiri melakukan siasatan di lokasi selepas detik 12 malam. Beliau terhidu bau Kapor Barus dan suara orang menangis dan mengilai berpanjangan.

programme.title: Arjuna
programme.desc: Gabungan para pendekar sakti melawan Lang Kajai dan Nading menyebabkan mereka mundur dan kabur. Arjuna bermeditasi di bawah kawalan Dzulkarnain untuk mengenali masa silamnya di mana dia ialah anak kepada pasangan pendekar sakti dan dirinya mempunyai keistimewaan.

programme.title: Parole Examiner Lee EP2
programme.desc: Han-shin menimbulkan kemarahan pihak berkuasa apabila menolak permohonan pembebasan seorang tokoh berpengaruh. Seo-yoon menemui petunjuk yang menghubungkan kesnya dengan seorang banduan yang sedang menunggu parol.

programme.title: The Exorcism Of Emily Rose
programme.desc: Berdasarkan kisah benar, filem ini mengisahkan tentang seorang paderi yang dihadapkan ke mahkamah selepas seorang gadis muda, Emily Rose, meninggal dunia semasa upacara menghalau syaitan. Melalui perbicaraan tersebut, terungkai kisah mengerikan tentang penderitaan Emily akibat gangguan makhluk halus dan dilema antara kepercayaan agama serta penjelasan saintifik.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP4
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di sebuah pusat sukan ekstrim di Kg. Lagong, Batu Caves, Selangor. Pengantara menemu bual pemilik pusat tersebut Encik Affandi dan Encik John Bear seorang pengunjung. Mereka bberkongsi pelbagai pengalaman misteri semasa berada di pusat riadah berkenaan. Pengantara bersama John Bear berserta krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi gangguan lembaga misteri dan bunyi menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan. John Bear juga berkongsi pengalaman yang baru dilaluinya.

programme.title: Wangi
programme.desc: Nor dan suaminya, Khuzairi tinggal di sebuah banglo bersama dua anak mereka. Selepas melahirkan anak kedua, Nor pulang ke rumah dan ibunya datang untuk menjaganya. Dia perasan bahawa pembantu rumahnya, Bella telah hilang. Bella seperti adik kepada Nor dan dia tinggal bersama mereka. Suaminya mengatakan bahawa Bella telah kembali ke Amsterdam untuk berkahwin. Nor mengesyaki dan tidak lama kemudian anak-anaknya mula mempunyai kelakuan luar biasa. Anak pertama mereka suka bercakap dengan dirinya sendiri dan tidur di tempat yang rawak; suaminya menyembunyikan rahsia manakala seorang wanita tua sentiasa memberi amaran kepada Nor. Tanpa disedari oleh Nor, Bella yang hilang mungkin sedang mengintai di sudut gelap banglo itu.

Beliau menemu bual Pak Jabar seorang penduduk tempatan dan bekas pekerja di situ bagi berkongsi pengalaman dan latar belakang tempat tersebut. Pak Jabar pernah ternampak lembaga berambut panjang dengan wajah yang hodoh. Pengantara kemudiannya menemu bual Tok Bugis seorang Penjejak Paranormal mempunyai kelebihan nampak lembaga misteri. Pengantara sendiri melakukan siasatan di lokasi selepas detik 12 malam. Beliau terhidu bau Kapor Barus dan suara orang menangis dan mengilai berpanjangan.

programme.title: The Exorcism Of Emily Rose
programme.desc: Berdasarkan kisah benar, filem ini mengisahkan tentang seorang paderi yang dihadapkan ke mahkamah selepas seorang gadis muda, Emily Rose, meninggal dunia semasa upacara menghalau syaitan. Melalui perbicaraan tersebut, terungkai kisah mengerikan tentang penderitaan Emily akibat gangguan makhluk halus dan dilema antara kepercayaan agama serta penjelasan saintifik.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP13
programme.desc: Alia menyalahkan Ritz serta Dr Flora kerana menukar dan merahsiakan identitinya. Dia kesal seolah-olah dirinya dipermainkan walaupun setelah Ritz menjelaskan untuk keselamatan. Zacky mencari jalan untuk meyakin Alia dia tidak lagi berdendam terhadap Affiyah. Semetara itu rahsia Sophie mempergunakan Dr Zahir untuk memisahkan Affiyah dengan Zacky terbongkar. Adam dan Rafeeq sebenarnya ahli keluarga yang dikhianati oleh Tan Seri Jalaludin. Mereka bergabung untuk menghapuskan musuh-musuh mereka termasuk Affiyah, saksi utama kejadian bunuh.Sementara itu Zacky dan Sha gembira melihat bapa mereka sedar dari koma. Kegembiraan mereka disaksikan Tan Seri Jalaludin secara bersembunyi

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP14
programme.desc: Adam menyiasat kes kehilangan Nora. Suspek utama ialah Dr Zahir berdasarkan mimpi Alia.Dr Flora mengizinkan Alia dan Susan membawa Adam ke rumah Dr Zahir. Mereka pelik melihat Dr Zahir pulang bersama Sophie.Mereka menyelinap masuk dan mengesyaki sesuatu. Nyawa Sophie terancam apabila terjumpa mayat mangsa-mangsa Zahir dalam sebuah bilik. Berlaku perselisihan antara mereka yang jelas didengar oleh Adam,Alia dan Susan. Perselisihan itu menyebabkan Sophie dibunuh. Rahsia dia mengupah Dr Zakir untuk membunuh Alia dan Kai turut terbongkar.Dr Zahir dapat menghidu kehadiran Alia dan Susan. Dalam situasi berasingan Ritz didera dan diancam bunuh oleh seorang lelaki bertopeng

programme.title: Taxi 3
programme.desc: Sekumpulan pencuri yang menggelarkan diri mereka sebagai Geng Santa Claus sedang menimbulkan kekacauan, dan polis tidak dapat mengejarnya. Kapten polis Gilbert terganggu oleh seorang wartawan Cina yang menulis cerita tentang skuadnya, isteri detektif Emilien baru sahaja mengumumkan bahawa dia hamil, dan pemandu teksi Daniel sedang mengalami krisis hubungan. Selepas rentetan kesilapan di mana pencuri mengakali polis berkali-kali dengan wartawan di sana untuk merakam semuanya, Daniel dan teksi supernya masuk.

programme.desc: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild
programme.desc: Palau is a tiny country with a big story. In 2009, this island nation in the middle of the western Pacific Ocean created the world's first shark sanctuary to protect more than 100 shark species from reckless overfishing and the brutal practice of commercial shark finning. Then, in 2014, Palau once again led the way. It established the world's largest marine sanctuary - a no-go zone for foreign commercial fisheries nearly the size of California.

programme.title: Alaskan Summer
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to August, Alaska becomes a paradise for it's wildlife.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa
programme.desc: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here - from the magnificent to the bizarre. This is the Garden Route National Park.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa
programme.desc: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing - water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. It's a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word “oukurubes” which means “place of thunder” in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-beaten world with flashes of brilliant color and a thunderous roar.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africa's greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if they're to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa
programme.desc: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent - Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19th century, the park's establishment gave rhinos a lifeline - breeding them back from extinction.

programme.title: Island Of The Monsoon
programme.desc: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

programme.title: Island Of The Monsoon

Echa sedih menyangkakan Ammar tidak puasa kerana bau kari melekat di baju Ammar. Rupa-rupanya bau kari disebabkan kari Cabi yang melekat di baju Ammar sewaktu Ammar dan rakan-rakannya kantoikan Chuby tidak puasa.

programme.title: Tim Mama
programme.desc: Amer panik, tak tahu nak balas apa. Lalu dia bergegas jumpa Syaiful, minta Syaiful tolong balaskan mesej dari Nina. Manakala Nina yang pada mulanya merasa ini hanya gangguan scammer, akhirnya terjebak berbalas mesej dengan lelaki yang hanya memberi nama Sam kepadanya itu.

programme.title: Ibadah Dalam Islam
programme.desc: Bersama Ustazah Nor Adibah yang akan membincangkan topik mengenai “Bersangka Baik”. Program ini menceritakan topik berdasarkan asas-asas ibadah dalam Islam. Melalui program ini penonton akan dapat pelbagai info dan ilmu tentang ciri, matlamat dan tujuan ibadah dalam kehidupan seharian kita.

programme.title: Jom Tengok
programme.desc: Jom Tengok adalah sebuah rancangan masakan yang bakal menampilkan Cef Bunga yang handal membuat Kek dan dalam episod kali ini menampilkan Fizo Omar sebagai selebriti jemputan dan mereka akan menghasilkan kek pandan gula melaka.

programme.title: #ustazmasak
programme.desc: Rancangan ini menampilkan pengacara Fendi Mohammad yang akan mengembara ke destinasi riadah menarik bersama seorang ustaz jemputan. Berkonsepkan 'outdoor cooking', rancangan ini membawakan resepi ringkas namun sedap yang akan dimasak bersama Fendi Mohammad dan Ustaz jemputan. Santai namun tetap menyelitkan informasi berguna dari Fendi dan juga Ustaz Jemputan. Bersama menemani Cef Fendi pada episod kali ini bersama Ustaz Hilman

programme.title: Jom Fesyen
programme.desc: Jom Fesyen musim kali ini bersama pengacara anda Nadia Brian yang akan membawa para penonton mengembara ke negara jiran iaitu Indonesia. Episod kali ini Nadia akan membawa para penonton ke beberapa pusat fesyen batik di Solo.

programme.title: Sahabat Sahabat Nabi
programme.desc: Episod ini akan membicarakan mengenai sahabat nabi iaitu Said bin Amir Al-Jumahi r.a. Umat Islam yang dikenali sahabat nabi dianggap mempunyai hubungan terus dengan Nabi Muhammad s.a.w dan mereka bukanlah pendusta atau menentang ajaran Islam. Jika meraka melihatnya, mendengarnya, atau berada di hadapan baginda walau sekejap mereka dianggap sebagai sahabat nabi s.a.w.

programme.title: Ceritaku
programme.desc: Ceritaku adalah sebuah program realiti mengisahkan seorang wartawan hiburan bernama Siti Khadijah yang prihatin dengan keadaan sekeliling dan ingin membantu insan-insan yang tidak berkemampuan. Siti Khadijah yang peka dengan kesusahan mereka yang tidak bernasib baik ini akan mencari VIP dan usahawan untuk membantu meringankan beban insan-insan yang tidak berkemampuan ini.

programme.title: Inikah Dikatakan Cinta
programme.desc: Pada mulanya Daus keberatan melepaskan Lyssa dan meminta maaf di atas perbuatannya, tetapi campurtangan ibu Lyssa membuatkan Daus terpaksa melepaskan Lyssa. Daus seolah hilang arah setelah kehilangan kedua-dua isterinya lebih-lebih lagi Mia. Setelah dipujuk oleh Daus dan Mak Ani, Mia akhirnya bersetuju untuk bersemuka dengan Daus. Daus berterus terang dengan Mia yang dia cintakan Mia sejak dari sekolah lagi. Daus memberitahu Mia dia ada meninggalkan surat kepada Mak Ani, tetapi Mia menafikan dia ada menerima surat itu. Daus terus memujuk Mia, tetapi Mia masih belum dapat menerima Daus dan menolak untuk rujuk kembali

Walaupun terpencil, namun jasa mereka menghidupkan semula bara-bara islam amat membanggakan. Keluarga Talep mendidik dan menghantar anak-anaknya belajar berbahasa inggeris dari kecil walaupun dikutuk penduduk kerana takut akidah mereka akan terpesong akibat terpengaruh. programme.title: Matahariku
programme.desc: Manisah kehilangan anaknya yang bernama Mira disebakan kemalangan dan menyalahkan Khairul. Mira yang merupakan penderma organ menderma organnya kepada Alisya. Alisya cuba mencari pewaris kepada penderma organnya dan akhirnya bertemu dengan Manisah. Apabila Manisah dapat tahu hubungan Alisya dengan Khairul membuatkan Manisah bertambah marah. Kesedihan Alisya tiba apabila ibunya meninggal dunia. Manisah yang dapat tahu menenteramkan Alisya bahawa dia sebagai ibu sentiasa ada dengan Alisya.

programme.desc: Airra merasa cukup bahagia apabila menyintai dan dicintai Aqil. Lelaki kacak yang dikenalinya semenjak berada di universiti itu sudah bersedia untuk menoktahkan cinta mereka dengan ikatan perkahwinan. programme.title: Bro, Nampak Motor Gua?
programme.desc: Epol membeli motosikal baru menggunakan simpanannya, kemudian membawanya untuk ditunjuk-tunjuk. Malangnya, motosikal itu dicuri oleh dua pencuri. Semasa mencari motornya, Epol bertembung dengan Azura yang beg tangannya turut diragut oleh kumpulan yang sama. Dipecah dalam beg Azura ialah thumb drive yang mengandungi maklumat penting milik Tan Sri Bakhtiar, seorang ahli perniagaan ternama.

programme.title: Sahabat Backpackers
programme.desc: Memaparkan Dai Raisyah dan Dai Shafiqah sebagai hos rancangan mengembara ke Aceh, Indonesia. Banda Aceh telah dilanda Tsunami pada 29 Disember 2004, telah mengorbankan seramai 46,718 penduduknya. Lokasi pertama yang dikunjungi ialah Kuburan Massal. Seramai 46, 718 mangsa terkorban mangsa Tsunami telah dikebumikan di sini. Saudara Irfan Kamal salah seorang pelajar Malaysia di sini menceritakan detik-detik berlaku Tsunami. Katanya dalam keadaan dharurat, mereka yang meninggal dunia boleh dikebumikan secara beramai-ramai. Terdapat sebuah bot tersangkut pada sebuah rumah dan masih dikekalkan, bot ini telah menyelamatkan 59 orang. Hos mengunjungi keluarga Syaifun Muhammad Yusri dan isterinya Puan Nilawati Ilyas yang merupakan mangsa tsumani. Mereka menceritakan detik-detik kejadian sehingga kehilangan ibu dan anak mereka. Pelancong Malaysia telah mewakafkan sebidang tanah dan pembinaan masjid di sana. Masih terdapat sebuah masjid masih ampuh dan tidak terkesan dengan kejadian tsunami iaitu Masjid Tahmatullah. Seterusnya ke Masjid Agung Al-Makmur Lampriek. Pada setiap hujung minggu jalan raya ditutup bagi membolehkan penduduk beriadah dan bersenam. Hos juga mengunjungi kapal besar yang dinamakan Rumah Apung. Kapal ini menjadi sebagai sumber menjana letrik kepada orang kampung terletak di tepi pantai. Kapal ini sepanjang 63 meter mampu 1.5 kilo watt letrik.

programme.title: Kahwin 5

Kehidupannya tenang hingga dia terlibat dengan skandal bersama Farra, seorang setiausaha muda yang bersaudara dengan ketua gangster, Cico. Dr K ditekan untuk berkahwin lagi - mencetus dilema: kekalkan empat isteri atau cerai salah seorang demi menyelamatkan nyawa

programme.title: Tok Guru
programme.desc: Gabenor Inggeris risau Malayan Union akan gagal jika orang Melayu terus buat demostrasi. Za'aba, Ahmad Boestamam dan Dr Baharudin Helmi terus berceramah di seluruh pelusuk tanah Melayu memberi penjelasan keburukkan jika orang melayu menerima Malayan Union.

programme.title: Misteri Mary Kuale
programme.desc: Aileena sebenarnya anak angkat kepada Puan Katrina dan Tuan Haidar. Mereka menemui Aileena di dalam sebuah kotak yang ditinggalkan di tepi tong sampah. Pada masa tersebut, Puan Katrina dan Tuan Haidar baru dua tahun berkahwin. Melihat sahaja bayi perempuan yang comel itu, Puan Katrina langsung jatuh kasih dan meminta izin kepada suaminya untuk menjaga bayi itu. Aileena sentiasa didatangi mimpi mengenai seorang wanita gila berketurunan cina . Dalam mimpinya itu Aileena dipanggil anak dan dia sentiasa melarikan diri daripada wanita itu. adakah maksud tersirat disebalik mimpi itu?

programme.title: Sahabat Backpackers
programme.desc: Memaparkan Dai Raisyah dan Dai Shafiqah sebagai hos rancangan mengembara ke Aceh, Indonesia. Banda Aceh telah dilanda Tsunami pada 29 Disember 2004, telah mengorbankan seramai 46,718 penduduknya. Lokasi pertama yang dikunjungi ialah Kuburan Massal. Seramai 46, 718 mangsa terkorban mangsa Tsunami telah dikebumikan di sini. Saudara Irfan Kamal salah seorang pelajar Malaysia di sini menceritakan detik-detik berlaku Tsunami. Katanya dalam keadaan dharurat, mereka yang meninggal dunia boleh dikebumikan secara beramai-ramai. Terdapat sebuah bot tersangkut pada sebuah rumah dan masih dikekalkan, bot ini telah menyelamatkan 59 orang. Hos mengunjungi keluarga Syaifun Muhammad Yusri dan isterinya Puan Nilawati Ilyas yang merupakan mangsa tsumani. Mereka menceritakan detik-detik kejadian sehingga kehilangan ibu dan anak mereka. Pelancong Malaysia telah mewakafkan sebidang tanah dan pembinaan masjid di sana. Masih terdapat sebuah masjid masih ampuh dan tidak terkesan dengan kejadian tsunami iaitu Masjid Tahmatullah. Seterusnya ke Masjid Agung Al-Makmur Lampriek. Pada setiap hujung minggu jalan raya ditutup bagi membolehkan penduduk beriadah dan bersenam. Hos juga mengunjungi kapal besar yang dinamakan Rumah Apung. Kapal ini menjadi sebagai sumber menjana letrik kepada orang kampung terletak di tepi pantai. Kapal ini sepanjang 63 meter mampu 1.5 kilo watt letrik.

programme.title: Kembara
programme.desc: Bersama Hos, Shahrul Kamal membawa penonton mengembara dan mencuba pelbagai aktiviti luar di Lata Kolam Air Deru Ecopark, Jerteh, Terengganu.

programme.title: Nur
programme.desc: Nur menolak cadangan Adam untuk tinggal di rumah ibunya. Hubungan mereka dingin gara-gara itu tetapi akhirnya Adam berlembut hati dan akur dengan keputusan Nur. Juita datang ke rumah Nur untuk minta maaf kepada mereka suami isteri. Adam di dalam bilik tidak mendengar perbualan Juita dan Nur dengan jelas. Suraya begitu kecewa dan marah mendapat tahu Amirul adalah anak Ayah Hj dan Amirul jugalah insan berhati mulia yang membayar yuran PMR untuknya. Dia rasa terhina kerana menjadi buah mulut rakan-rakan sekolah bahawa dia sangat beruntung dapat kekasih anak Dato dan merupakan ketua pelajar. Bertambah malu, apabila gambar Amirul membantunya berniaga di pasar juga tersebar. Dia ambil keputusan untuk tidak bertemu dengan Amirul lagi. Petang itu Adam pulang dari kerja dan mendapat tahu Juita beri tabung kutipan derma. Lebih mengecewakan apabila Nur sendiri merayu pada Adam agar membimbing Juita keluar dari dunia gelap itu atas permintaan Juita sendiri. Nur yang percaya bulat-bulat pada Juita berharap suaminya bersetuju membimbing Juita berubah sepertinya. Sebaliknya Juita mempunyai rencana jahatnya tersendiri. Hamadi masih tidak berubah dan mahu menegakkan benang yang basah. Dia tetap dengan pendiriannya menyatakan dia tidak bersalah. Dia mahu Ayah Hj bantunya membayar guaman agar terlepas dari tuduhan mahkamah nanti. Ayah Haji naik berang dengan sikap menantunya itu. Hamadi menempelak bengang kerana tiada sesiapa pun di dalam rumah itu yang menyebelahinya. Tanpa diduga Hamadi singgah ke lorong pelacur seperti selalu tanpa diketahui sesiapa. Dia bertemu Juita tetapi Juita menolak Hamadi mentah-mentah kerana bawa duit sikit. Hamadi bengang. Tiba-tiba Juita terima panggilan yang mengejutkan dari Nur.

programme.title: Nur
programme.desc: Adam perhatikan Amirul gelisah sejak kebelakangan. Kini tahulah Adam, adikya sedang dilamun cinta dengan Suraya. Juita bertindak berani pergi ke Sek. Darul Mukhsin untuk mencari Adam. Dia berang Adam menolak duit sumbangan yang diberinya sebelum ini. Adam ceritkan pada Nur, Juita ada mengatakan Adam memilih-milih orang yang ingin dibimbingnya. Sebenarnya, Adam tidak selesa dengan Juita kerana tindakan berani gadis itu sebelum ini terhadapnya. Saban hari Aisyah tertekan dek desakan Hamadi untuk meminjam wang dari Ibu Hjh tetapi ibunya mahu minta kebenaran dari Ayah Hj. Ayah Hj bertambah geram mendengar hal itu, meluat melihat menantunya bermalasan di rumah, lantas Ibu Hjh menasihati Aishah menyuruh Hamadi keluar bekerja. Hamadi tidak peduli apa difikirkan keluarga itu asalkan dia dapat wang yang dia mahukan. Sebenarnya dia beriya-ia mahukan wang untuk melanggan Juita dari lorong untuk melempias nafsunya. Hubungan Amirul dan Suraya semakin renggang. Namun Amirul tidak berputus asa untuk mengetahui puncanya. Akhirnya, Suraya berterus terang sebab dia bersikap dingin tidak mahu jadi seperti ibunya yang hanyut dek termakan belas ihsan cinta lelaki dan malu disindir rakan-rakan sekolah kerana dituduh ambil kesempatan pada anak Datuk Ayah Hj. Amirul menegaskan dia betul-betul ikhlas membantu Suraya dan mahu berkawan dengan Suraya tanpa mengambil kira jurang darjat antara mereka. Suraya jadi lembut hati mendengar pengakuan itu. Satu hari, Adam dan Nur diajak bermalam di rumah Ayah Hj ketika singgah ke sana. Hamadi ambil kesempatan senyap-senyap ganggu mahu menyentuh Nur. Nur berlari ke balkoni mendapatkan Adam yang sedang berbual dengan Ayah Haji. Nur masih tidak berani berterus-terang membuatkan Hamadi semakin berani.

programme.title: Nur
programme.desc: Mulut Nur seakan terkunci untuk menceritakan hal sebenar. Keadaan menjadi tegang apabila Adam mengesyaki Hamadi melakukan sesuatu tidak senonoh pada Nur, melihatkan Nur kelihatan gelisah, tetapi Nur tidak mengakuinya. Hamadi hampir dicekik Adam, tetapi dileraikan Ayah Hj. Dengan rasa marah, Adam keluar sebentar ke lorong bertemu Juita setelah mendapatkan nasihat dari Ayah Hj. Sementara itu, Amirul berusaha mencari jalan bagi menyelesaikan salah faham antara Suraya dan rakan sekelasnya agar gadis pujaannya tidak difitnah dan disindir lagi. Malam itu, Hamadi mengetuk pintu bilik Nur dengan perlahan, merayu agar Nur melayaninya. Hamadi juga pernah menjadi pelanggan Nur suatu ketika dahulu. Nur didalam bilik sudah menangis ketakutan. Hamadi menyedari Amirul sedang memerhatinya dengan perasaan benci, tetapi dia tidak peduli dan mengejek Amirul. Di lorong, Adam mendengar kisah Juita. Sejak dahulu Juita akui dia cemburu dengan Nur yang sering mendapat perhatian lebih darinya, dan kini Nur beruntung mendapat suami seperti Adam. Jerat Juita semakin mengena. Adam hampir masuk ke dalam perangkapnya apabila Adam bersetuju membimbingnya, dengan syarat, Nur perlu ada bersama mereka setiap kali Juita datang belajar ke rumahnya. Juita kemudian memberikan semua pakaian seksinya kepada rakan-rakan serumah dengan alasan mahu bertaubat. Nur menegur cara Adam melayan Juita agak keras berbandingnya dahulu, Adam melayan dan membimbingnya dengan baik sekali sehingga Adam membelakangkan keluarganya. Adam sungguh tidak faham sebab Nur beriya-iya dan langsung tidak cemburu. Sedang Adam dan Nur berbual pintu rumah mereka diketuk. Terlihat Juita muncul dengan berbaju kurung serba ayu memeluk Nur sambil menangis. Hamadi yang tercabar oleh Aishah, keluar mencari kerja.

programme.title: Nur
programme.desc: Kali ini, Juita berpura-pura sudah insaf. Dia bawa beg berisi pakaian. Katanya dia dihalau dari rumah sewa oleh rakan-rakannya gara-gara mahu berubah ke arah kebaikan. Nur terkejut dan terus memujuk Juita yang kelihatan sangat sedih. Adam pula mendapat panggilan telefon dari Ustaz Yasin. Dia begitu terkejut mendengar Hamadi kembali ke Darul Mukhsin, menuntut jawatannya sebagai Pengetua, lantas bergegas ke sana. Sementara di Darul Mukhsin, semua terkejut dengan kehadiran Hamadi meminta buku cek. Setibanya di sekolah, Adam naik angin melihat Hamadi membelek-belek buku cek. Menurut Hamadi, dia masih berhak kerana Ayah Hj tidak pernah mengeluarkan surat perletakan jawatannya sepanjang dia di penjara. Hamadi sengaja membuatkan Adam hilang sabar sehingga Adam melepaskan satu tumbukan ke muka Hamadi. Hamadi berdendam dan tekad mendapatkan Sek. Darul Mukhsin. Dalam keadaan tergesa-gesa, Adam pulang mengambil Nur untuk ke rumah Ayah Hj. Dia terkejut dan bengang Nur membenarkan Juita tinggal di rumah itu tanpa berbincang dengannya. Juita terdengar dan salah faham, terus beredar kerana sangkakan Adam tidak menyukainya. Dalam pada itu, Suraya mengucapkan terima kasih atas tindakan adil Amirul mengedarkan buku-buku teks kepada pelajarpelajar miskin yang lain, demi menghentikan fitnah terhadap Suraya. Hamadi yang bertembung dengan Suraya sempat menegur dan melirik gadis itu dengan penuh nafsu. Suraya terpinga-pinga dan beredar. Petang itu, Amirul bantu Suraya dan neneknya menjual sayur di pasar. Mereka berbaik semula. Adam dapati ayah Hj tiada di rumah. Dia bersama Ibu Hjh keluar mencari Ayah Hj. Sementara itu, Nur tinggal dengan kakak iparnya, Aisyah. Nur lihat Aisyah bersedih dan cuba memujuknya. Sebaliknya Aisyah menuduh Nur mengambil tempatnya di rumah itu, kerana kini semua sayangkan Nur melebihinya

programme.title: Nur
programme.desc: Ketika Aisyah di dalam bilik, Hamadi pulang ke rumah. Memandangkan Nur bersendirian, Hamadi melangkah ke arah Nur dengan senyuman miang dan menerkam mahu merogol Nur. Nur memberanikan diri berhadapan dengan Hamadi yang bernafsu serakah, memukul-mukul Hamadi. Aisyah terdengar bunyi bising keluar lalu menolak Nur jatuh ke dalam kolam mandi dan berlakulah adegan tolak-menolak. Mujur Adam pulang ketika itu melihat Nur hampir lemas dan Hamadi yang sedang seronok melihat aksi mereka. Ayah Hj dan Ibu Hjh juga terperanjat. Nur sudah tidak tahan, dia berterus terang tentang sikap lelaki itu selama ini kepada mertuanya. Ayah Hj naik berang lalu menghalau Hamadi dan Aisyah keluar dari rumahnya. Malam itu, Adam dan Nur pulang ke rumah mereka. Adam keluar semula bertemu Juita mahu meminta maaf padanya. Atas Permintaan Nur, dia akhirnya bersetuju membawa Juita tinggal di rumahnya. Jarum Juita sudah mengena. Mereka tampak mesra, Nur agak cemburu melihat mereka bergurau ketika tiba di rumah. Malam itu, Adam yang kebetulan terbangun dari tidur dan ke dapur terdengar suara manja Juita sedang mengigau. Dia menguak pintu bilik Juita yang sengaja tidak berselimut agar Adam melihat tubuhnya. Adam panik apabila Juita membuka mata dan segera masuk ke biliknya. Adam menjadi tidak keruan. Juita tersenyum sinis. Sementara itu, Aisyah dan Hamadi yang terdesak tiada tempat tinggal terpaksa menginap di hotel bajet berhampiran lorong Hj. Taib. Hamadi senyum lega diselubungi nafsu tatkala melihat beberapa gadis di lorong itu. Malam itu, Hamadi membawa seorang pelacur ke bilik ketika Aisyah sedang tidur. Keesokannya, Aisyah terlihat sekeping cek diambil oleh Hamadi ketika datang ke Sek. Darul Mukhsin semalam. Dengan cemas, Hamadi jelaskan cek itu adalah gaji tunggakan yang harus dibayar padanya. Aisyah hanya mampu geleng kepala dengan fiil suaminya. Adam menghadiri mesyuarat lembaga pengarah Sek. Darul Mukhsin bagi membincangkan perihal sekolah yang sudah dalam keadaan tenat.

programme.title: Kahwin 5
programme.desc: Dr K (Usop Wilcha) ialah seorang usahawan mangkuk plastik dari Perak yang sudah mempunyai empat isteri dari negeri berbeza (Selangor, Kelantan, Negeri Sembilan, Sabah). Kehidupannya tenang hingga dia terlibat dengan skandal bersama Farra, seorang setiausaha muda yang bersaudara dengan ketua gangster, Cico. Dr K ditekan untuk berkahwin lagi - mencetus dilema: kekalkan empat isteri atau cerai salah seorang demi menyelamatkan nyawa

programme.title: 7 Minggu Sebelum Kahwin
programme.desc: Syifa (Nora Danish) mengimpikan majlis perkahwinan impian sejak kecil. Namun dengan hanya tujuh minggu sahaja sebelum hari besar, pelbagai konflik dan kekacauan berlaku, dari cincin kahwin yang tidak kena bentuk hingga kad jemputan yang dicetak salah. Setiap kekusutan menggugat kepercayaan dan hubungan cinta antara Syifa dan Amar (MK K Clique). Ketika tekanan bertambah, kemunculan bekas kekasih Amar (Natasha) membawa ketegangan besar yang akhirnya menjadi pertikaian antara mereka. Adakah Syifa dan Amar berjaya mengharungi konflik ini menjelang hari perkahwinan mereka?

programme.title: Tok Guru
programme.desc: Mr Johnson balik ke KL bincang dengan Headmaster Mr Daniel untuk buat pertandingan persahabatan dengan pelajar pondok Tok Guru Nik Ahmad. Mereka kata simboliknya nak tunjukkan bangsa dan empayar British mereka masih gagah dan berkuasa. Daniel setuju kerana ia boleh jadi bahan latihan sebelum bertanding dan berlawan dengan team Penang Free School,English College dan MCKK.

programme.title: Mr Delicious
programme.desc: Melina semakin rapat dengan Aiman, menyebabkan ketegangan meningkat dan salah faham berpanjangan.

programme.title: Stories In Taiwan
programme.desc: In a playful and relaxed style, the host went deep into the corners of various towns and villages in Taiwan, looking for the uniqueness, introduced the special local customs and traditions.

programme.title: Trails to Hakka
programme.desc: Taiwans Raknus Selu Trail, the countrys longest national nature trail, becomes the setting for a cross-cultural journey linking Taiwan and Korea. Led by Hakka artist Rio Peng and Korea-based YouTuber Baik Du, Korean artists Kim Ha Nel, Nam Wooh Yun, and Lee Jun Young explore the trail on foot, discovering its landscapes, culture, and healing power. programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show 'Top Singers' aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. programme.title: Cinta Metropolitan
programme.desc: Haris, seorang jurugambar bertemu semula dengan adiknya yang terkenal sebagai seorang casanova, Irwan. Tidak begitu senang dengan perangai adiknya yang suka menggoda sesiapa sahaja termasuk kekasihnya sendiri, hubungan mereka renggang. Satu sindiket pemalsuan wang terbongkar menyebabkan Haris, Irwan, Monisa dan dua orang lagi diburu sindiket itu sehingga ke luar negara.

programme.title: Sepi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tiga orang yang berasingan mengenal erti cinta, kehilangan dan kesepian. Adam, seorang tukang masak terkenal yang meluaskan kerjayanya dengan mereka hiasan untuk majlis perkahwinan. Tetapi, dengan segala kejayaan itu beliau masih membujang dan belum bertemu jodohnya sendiri. Sufi pula seorang lelaki yang sedang cuba melenyapkan memori kematian isterinya. Akhir sekali, Iman, seorang penulis muda yang menjadikan pentas teater sebagai tapak untuk memahami masa silamnya dan kupasan demi kupasan ke dalam masa depannya sendiri. Ketiga-tiga watak ini akhirnya terkait dalam satu insiden dramatik yang akan merubah kehidupan mereka buat selamanya.

programme.title: Castello
programme.desc: Solo mula menjalankan kegiatan sebagai pengedar dadah untuk menjadikan kehidupan keluarganya lebih mewah. Tapi Solo tertangkap dan dia dipenjara selama 20 tahun. Di dalam penjara, dia dikenali sebagai Castello. Keluar dari penjara, Castello cuba mengesan semula isteri dan anaknya. Tapi dia kecewa bila mengetahui anak gadisnya Phim telah menjadi penagih dadah. Castello berusaha untuk menyelamatkan Phim yang tidak menyedari bahawa Castello adalah bapanya

programme.title: Ke Medan Jaya
programme.desc: Hisham tinggal bersama ibunya, Mak Jah. Bapanya yang bekerja sebagai anggota tentera telah meninggal dunia akibat serangan musuh semasa zaman darurat. Sejak kematian suaminya, Mak Jah bekerja sebagai pembantu rumah dengan seorang hartawan bernama Pak Samad. Pak Samad dan isterinya tidak pernah menganggap Mak Jah sebagai pembantu rumah, malah Hisham dianggap seperti anak mereka sendiri dan mendapat pendidikan yang sama dengan Haryati, anak hartawan tersebut. Apabila wujud kemesraan antara mereka berdua, ibu bapa Haryati merasa bimbang kerana Haryati telah ditunangkan dengan Shahril. Setelah mengetahui kisah sebenar, Hisham mengambil Keputusan untuk menyertai angkatan tentera walaupun ditentang oleh ibunya.

programme.title: Maria Mariana 1
programme.desc: Dua beradik berbeza perwatakan - Maria, anak kebanggaan keluarga yang cemerlang dalam pelajaran - manakala Mariana, anak yang sering memberontak dan liar. Maria membesar menjadi seorang anggota polis namun Mariana masih sama seperti dahulu. Persengketaan terjadi apabila keduanya menyukai lelaki yang sama. Diculik geng, Maria sanggup menaruhkan nyawa demi menyelamatkan Mariana.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang percintaan dan persaingan siapa yang terbaik antara pemain papan selaju ketika kemuncak musik Hip Hop dan sukan papan selaju di negara. Khairul, ingin menjadi pemain papan selaju yang terbaik tetapi menemui kesulitan kerana lawannya, Mario yang juga sama mahir. Ingin memenangi hati Nelly, Khairul ingin terus membuktikan kehandalannya. Pada masa yang sama, Mario dan Mawar berpakat bersama-sama untuk memastikan mereka mendapat Khairul dan Nelly untuk diri mereka sendiri. programme.title: Warna-Warna Hati
programme.desc: Kisah seorang wanita yang terpaksa menguruskan sebuat syarikat besar tanpa bantuan keluarganya. Perniagaan syarikat milik keluarga Puan Rohani mengalami pelbagai masalah selepas Encik Osman, pengurus syarikat tersebut terlibat dalam kes penyelewengan wang syarikat. Anak-anak Puan Rohani yang tidak berminat untuk membantu ibunya dan mengambil tahu mengenai syarikat tersebut menyebabkan Puan Rohani memberi kepercayaan kepada Encik Osman. Puan Rohani juga cuba memujuk anak lelakinya, Hafsham yang baru tamat pengajian dari Amerika Syarikat untuk bekerja di syarikat itu dan membantunya untuk menguruskan syarikat

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, “Group friend” listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: News Magazine 2026 & Trick Or Cheat
programme.desc: "News Perspective" is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces."

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster" is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to "pass the level" can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT$100,000. programme.title: Profession Impossible
programme.desc: To showcase the talents of local fashion designers, TVB specially produced a fashion design competition reality show. Ten contestants advanced from the preliminary rounds to the semi-finals, each designing two pieces for their collaborating artists based on environmental and Chinese themes, competing for five spots in the finals. The final five faced a final test, creating two outfits each based on a unisex and evening gown theme, which they then paired with their artists to showcase their style on the Catwalk stage, where the champion, first runner-up, and second runner-up were determined! Hosts Nancy Wu and Benjamin Yuen, along with "star" judges Walter Ma, William So, Gigi Leung, Kathy Chow, Amanda S., and others, witnessed the journey of "The Tailoring Magician".

programme.title: The Taste Of Us
programme.desc: Delicious food, bursting with color, aroma, and flavor, not only fills the stomach but also soothes the soul! Liangliang (Mason Fung), a freelancer who loves singing and food, is feeling lost after breaking up with his girlfriend Jessica (Carmen Ngai). To prove his financial independence, he rents out his vacant room. His tenant, Azhi (Zeno Koo ), is a cooking enthusiast who frequently unleashes his culinary skills, creating a variety of heartwarming dishes such as "Miso Clam Soup" and "Chicken and Avocado Mexican Rolls"... The two young men hit it off immediately, satisfying each other's hunger and filling each other's voids! What kind of interesting relationship will these two very different personalities build?

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. programme.title: Not Far From Here
programme.desc: Even with limited vacation time, you can still embark on a trip to explore the Greater Bay Area, thanks to Not Far From Here C Kwan,Billy Luk and Karen Wu team up to uncover travel information, savoring modern Cantonese cuisine, top-notch vegetarian dishes, exquisite French food, and the delightful Omakase dessert. A sensory feast of exotic insects awaits. Immerse yourself in a jazz whiskey bar, enjoying vinyl music and stand-up comedy performances. Leisure and entertainment abound, including luxurious massage treatments, a five-star buffet, and a variety of recreational facilities. What's it like to experience a storm-themed spa? Dress up and enjoy an escape room adventure - thrilling enough! The team will also visit trendy areas and Western antique museums to find their favorite items.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Kwoks And What, The
programme.desc: Seasoned Chinese frog closure instructor Kwok-Law Mei-lan (Paw Hee Ching) has raised her children and grandchildren by herself. She discovers everybody's issues before her 70th birthday. Her eldest son Kwok Tak-kan's (Joe Ma) business has failed, and he is also divorcing his wife Tian Yu-fei (Natalie Tong). Her second daughter Kwok Tak-bo (Che Yuen Yuen) and her son Kwok King-hin (Fei Wu) are drifting apart, and her relationship with her boyfriend has also ended. Her youngest son Kwok Tak-ming (Mat Yeung) loses his job as Tak-kan has got him into trouble. While Mei-lan wants to help her children solve their problems, she also plans to team up with her favorite disciple Chong Zi-chang (Grace Wong) to pass down the craft. Meanwhile, Tak-kan and his siblings keep contradicting each other. And gangster Kwok Chung-shek (Eddie Kwan) abruptly shows up and claims he has 50% ownership of the Kwoks' property. Can Mei-lan's strict adherence to the Kwoks motto “Keep walking and there's a way out” unite family members in the confrontation against the enemy?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2021
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Legal Mavericks 2020
programme.desc: Blind barrister Man Sun-hop (Vincent Wong), aka Perception Man, has a superlative fourth sense. He teams up with female legal executive Chiu Ching-mui (Sisley Choi) and private investigator Kut Yat-ha (Owen Cheung) to seek justice for the underprivileged. They never hesitate to use tactics that involve “pushing the boundaries”. Barrister Shaw Mei-la (Kelly Cheung) earnestly approaches Sun-hop. They are then to fight it out in court. Also, Mei-la's pupil master Kan Siu-wang (Paul Chun) constantly back Mei-la up. While Sun-hop was serving his pupillage with his pupil master Siu-wang, a homicide case involving some missing corpse had caused Shifu and his disciple to become foes. Sun-hop presents new evidence and lodges an appeal for the defendant. He and Siu-wang again confront each other, causing successive rounds of conflict. Meanwhile, the emergence of Mei-la brings about subtle changes in the formidable Sun-hop, Ching-mui and Yat-ha's triangular relationship.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50

In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4
programme.desc: " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4" has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating "masked," igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants; Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new season's stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4."

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins. Apart from his discovery of HAU-YEE's dubious death, the best friend of the late HAU-YEE, TONG BING-BING (Tavia Yeung) also has a feeling of suspicion, so the two decide to launch an investigation.

programme.title: Silver Chamber Of Sorrows, The
programme.desc: “Sheung's Silver Chamber”, the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM's family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG's younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM's family. Fueled by hatred, CHING SAU-HANG (Ng Wing Mei), WAN's lover, marries HANG and ironically becomes WAN's sister-in-law. WAN falls out with HANG, and opts to live abroad and disconnects from his family. After leaving home for years, WAN does not return home until the occasion to celebrate his father's birthday. Tension between the two brothers comes to a head when HANG is reluctant to pay ransom to save the youngest son of WAN. WAN is determined to disconnect completely from his family ever since. Since WAN's return, SAU-HANG suffers from her husband's neglect and gets framed for causing the fourth concubine FEI FEI's (Wu Ting Yan) miscarriage. Hatred leads her to commit act that revenge. She seeks to subvert SHEUNG's family by luring KWAN. Intentionally, she unveils TSAU KUK (Yeung Sze Ki), the maid in the family, is HANG's illegitimate daughter. The dark age of a once-prominent family begins…

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long's two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei's (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love. The two sisters have found the right guys. Tsz-long and Hoi-kei never miss any job opportunity as they want to have their own love nest. The couple move into a 100-square-foot plus subdivided unit after getting married. They not only have to deal with daily inconveniences due to insufficient space but also need to handle emotional issues of their aging parents on both sides.

programme.title: Pages Of Treasures
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that “knowledge is power”. He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING's further studies on computer sciences in America. The two brothers return to Hong Kong eventually and they work in the same commercial building. CHING works as a senior network security engineer while MING works as a junior security guard. MAN worries that the difference in their job ranking will hinder their relationship. MING admires a girl YUEN WAI CHUNG (Kwok Sonija) who opens a paper mud figure shop. MAN tries to help MING establish his career by buying a secondhand bookshop for him to operate. However, MAN doesn't realize that the virtual world is gradually manipulating his family. CHING meets a romanticist TSU HEI MAN (Yeo Vivien) at work which creates misunderstanding between him and his girlfriend, LUI YUEN YI (Yeung Shirley). MAN's younger daughter FONG SUM MEI (Ho Lily) indulges herself in the virtual world and she is suspected for stealing exam papers on the internet…

programme.title: Legend Of Master Chai, The
programme.desc: In Heaven, Chai (Leung Wing Chun) killed Huen (Ho Po Sang) over a pot of sweet lotus seed soup. He was expelled to earth to suffer, while at the same time, he had to help Huen and Nui, who were also sent down to earth, to regain their powers. Chai was punished to become the stupid and shabby son, of an earthly man. Huen, on the other hand, was his handsome and clever brother, who was loved by all. One day, Chai regained his magic power and started to challenge Huen. Their relationship worsened as they both fell in love with Nui (Leung Siu Bing)…

Tension between the two brothers comes to a head when HANG is reluctant to pay ransom to save the youngest son of WAN. WAN is determined to disconnect completely from his family ever since. Since WAN's return, SAU-HANG suffers from her husband's neglect and gets framed for causing the fourth concubine FEI FEI's (Wu Ting Yan) miscarriage. Hatred leads her to commit act that revenge. She seeks to subvert SHEUNG's family by luring KWAN. Intentionally, she unveils TSAU KUK (Yeung Sze Ki), the maid in the family, is HANG's illegitimate daughter. The dark age of a once-prominent family begins…

programme.title: Pages Of Treasures
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that “knowledge is power”. He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING's further studies on computer sciences in America. The two brothers return to Hong Kong eventually and they work in the same commercial building. CHING works as a senior network security engineer while MING works as a junior security guard. MAN worries that the difference in their job ranking will hinder their relationship. MING admires a girl YUEN WAI CHUNG (Kwok Sonija) who opens a paper mud figure shop. MAN tries to help MING establish his career by buying a secondhand bookshop for him to operate. However, MAN doesn't realize that the virtual world is gradually manipulating his family. CHING meets a romanticist TSU HEI MAN (Yeo Vivien) at work which creates misunderstanding between him and his girlfriend, LUI YUEN YI (Yeung Shirley). MAN's younger daughter FONG SUM MEI (Ho Lily) indulges herself in the virtual world and she is suspected for stealing exam papers on the internet…

programme.title: Ultimate Addiction, The
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases. His brother-in-law CHOW SUN-YUNG (Ben Wong), one of the CCB inspectors, is determined to put him in jail, collaborating with superior HO SHEUNG-YEE (Sharon Chan) and subordinate CHI NGA (Kate Tsui) to gather evidence. SUN-YUNG thinks highly of CHI NGA and even regards her as his last apprentice, to his surprise, CHI NGA suddenly resigns and starts working for CHEUK YUK.
